Link targets: only rooms, history, gallery, press, contact, wellness, dining, neighborhood, meetings and guidelines map to existing pages. amenities, services (x2), corporate, resortpass, packages, the four dining venues, in-room dining, privacy policy, accessibility and the three social URLs need hrefs (placeholders are '#'). CMS pages (dining venues, legal, corporate) arrive with Q027 to Q030.
'Studio circa' credit link URL is not in the design.

No mobile or tablet frames exist in the snapshot. Tablet (3 columns), mobile landscape (2 columns, stacked bottom row with logo first) and mobile portrait values are proposals; confirm or supply a mobile design.

Section element: plan uses <section role="contentinfo"> to keep the section_ convention. A plain <footer> tag is the semantic alternative, but CLAUDE.md reserves <footer> for CTA wrappers and GSAP code targets the .footer class; confirm.

Container: the design runs edge to edge at 40px margins on a 1600 frame. The plan uses padding-global (2rem) with no container-large, so columns span the full width as in Figma. Adding container-large would cap content at 80rem and leave much wider margins at 1440.
deviations: The brief lists optional element gatch-20 on dining-gardenterrace, dining-lobbybar and dining-poollounge. Spec inspection shows it belongs to Group 270990062 (an 'other dining options' slider with H2 heading, Gatch 20 body, #D9D9D9 placeholders and arrows) whose bbox overlaps the footer band (y 308 to 844 on a 700px footer, crop heights 844). It is not part of the footer: those three footers are identical to the other 21. No optional element is planned; the slider belongs to the dining venue page entries.

Background image: the Figma rectangle (1601x1678, scaleMode FILL on a 1667x2500 jpg) starts 978px above the footer and is shared with the book-your-escape section above it. The footer shows image rows 56% to 85%, reproduced with object-fit cover and object-position 50% 80% (exact at about 1500px wide, within a few percent at 1440 and 1600). If the design intends one continuous image across both sections, that is a page-level decision for the book-your-escape entry.

Overlay: the rectangle has a third fill the snapshot spec omits (read from figma/raw/file.json.gz): a black linear gradient at 65% layer opacity, transparent at the rectangle top to opaque at 67.6%. Over the footer band that is 56% black at the top rising to 65% at 22% down, then flat. The plan stacks it over the 20% black fill on footer-links_overlay.
Side margin is 2rem (padding-global) instead of the Figma 40px (2.5rem at 1600 wide).
Copyright year is wrapped in <span data-current-year> so the currentYear module keeps it current.
Section background-color var(--_primitives---colors--neutral-darkest) is a fallback under the image so text stays legible while it loads; not in Figma.
